BiblicalUsage: Zuwr means to press or squeeze — wounds that have not been closed up nor bound up nor mollified with ointment, in Isaiah's picture of a beaten nation; Gideon wringing the dew out of the fleece; the ostrich crushing her eggs in the dust. Pressing can heal a wound, wring out dew, or destroy what was meant to live.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the same pressing tells three stories: a wound left unpressed, a fleece that yields its dew, and an egg crushed by carelessness — and God knows which pressing each of us needs.
